tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established within the Bureau an Explosives Training and Research Facility at Fort AP Hill, Fredericksburg, Virginia.

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: The facility established under subsection (a) shall be utilized to train Federal, State, and local law enforcement officers to—

children.text: properly handle, utilize, and dispose of explosive materials and devices;
train canines on explosive detection; and

children.heading: In general
children.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to establish and maintain the facility established under subsection (a).

children.heading: Availability of funds
children.text: Any amounts appropriated pursuant to paragraph (1) shall remain available until expended.
